text: Pip had a theory. Gulls usually do. At noon he would count every person on the island, and every shadow.
Two hundred and six people. Two hundred and seven shadows.
He found the extra one on the cliff path. It was walking beside Gus, step for step, close enough to hold his hand.
Gus had two shadows now. One of them wore a hat.
Pip told Gus. Gus did not turn around.
He said he had felt it since the pool. Cold, on his left side, like standing too close to the sea.
